## Research projects

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
S-LAB, Jeonbuk National University · Feb 2026 – present
:::

[Transferability and Configuration Sensitivity of Clinical Prediction Models across Imaging, Time-Series, and Tabular Data](project-transferability.qmd){.research-title}

Whether a transfer-learning gain survives the training configuration — seeds,
splits, prevalence, thresholds, noise — across breast imaging, glucose time
series, and tabular COVID-19 outcomes.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-transferability.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
S-LAB, Jeonbuk National University · Aug 2026 – present
:::

[Chest CT-Based Prediction of Pulmonary Function and Evaluation of Model Explainability](project-airway-ct.qmd){.research-title}

Predicts airflow limitation from correlated quantitative CT measures, then asks
whether competing explanations agree on *why*.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-airway-ct.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Department of Statistics, Jeonbuk National University · Aug 2026 – present
:::

[A Bootstrap Algorithm for Comparing Diagnostic Test Accuracy in Meta-Analysis with Within-Study Correlation](project-dauc-bootstrap.qmd){.research-title}

A correlation-aware bootstrap for comparing two diagnostic tests in
meta-analysis when the same participants took both.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-dauc-bootstrap.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
University of Nevada, Las Vegas · Jun – Jul 2025
:::

[Deep Neural Networks for Mortality Prediction from EHR Vital-Sign Time Series](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-title}

Mortality prediction from irregularly sampled vital signs, crossing two
interpolation schemes with two network architectures.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-ehr-mortality.qmd){.research-btn}
:::

:::

::: {.research-card}

::: {.research-label}
Department of Statistics, Jeonbuk National University · Mar – Jun 2025
:::

[Deep Learning-based Neural Granger Causality for Solar Radiation Time Series](project-granger.qmd){.research-title}

Whether neural Granger causality recovers predictive relationships among
meteorological variables that a linear vector autoregression misses.

::: {.research-links}
[Project page](project-granger.qmd){.research-btn}
